guarantees.text: Every fact and commitment in the State API MUST carry one of three epistemic states (adoption), and separately a freshness value: [Q1]
guarantees.maop_section: State: epistemic status, freshness and causal invalidation
guarantees.note: Same three adoption states and separate freshness value (EpistemicStatus, Freshness).

guarantees.text: Whenever a new fact F_new supersedes an existing fact F_old (setting F_old.transaction_time.superseded_at), the Creasura kernel MUST, synchronously and within the same database transaction, re-evaluate every dependent commitment or fact reachable through reverse depends_on_fact_ids and depends_on_alternatives edges: [Q2]
guarantees.maop_section: State: epistemic status, freshness and causal invalidation
guarantees.note: Obligation unchanged; subject reworded from 'the Creasura kernel' to 'the runtime' (vendor-neutral). MAOP also treats each invalidation as a trigger for supervision.evaluate (event-driven re-evaluation of durable guards).

guarantees.text: - The kernel MUST enforce a declared max_invalidation_subgraph limit. An update whose affected subgraph exceeds it is rejected before commit with CAOP_413_INVALIDATION_SUBGRAPH_TOO_LARGE (HTTP 413, in the v0.1 error envelope), and nothing is partially applied. [Q2]
guarantees.maop_section: State: epistemic status, freshness and causal invalidation
guarantees.note: Same max_invalidation_subgraph limit and CAOP_413_INVALIDATION_SUBGRAPH_TOO_LARGE error code.

guarantees.text: The kernel MUST reject unknown or cross-workspace fact IDs in depends_on_fact_ids or depends_on_alternatives with CAOP_422_PRECOMMIT_UNKNOWN_FACT_ID. [Q3]
guarantees.maop_section: Guards: policy and pre-commit hooks (durable guards)
guarantees.note: Same CAOP_422_PRECOMMIT_UNKNOWN_FACT_ID rejection; MAOP models it as an evidence Guard.

guarantees.text: Every capability registered in the Capability API MUST declare its execution locus, credential custodian, lease timeout, provider-specific receipt verification keys, and Stage-2 promotion thresholds.
guarantees.note: Same CapabilityRegistration obligations; agents.register advertises capabilities lazily.

guarantees.text: To prevent conversational LLMs from treating dispatch as a completed turn and replying to the user before invoking their native tool, caop_dispatch_work in Stage 1 MUST return the following continuation envelope:

A workspace thread MAY hold at most one unsettled EXECUTE_DISPATCHED or EXECUTE_EXPIRED invocation at a time. Any call to caop_stage_work or caop_dispatch_work while a lease is open MUST be rejected with CAOP_409_UNSETTLED_EXECUTION_LEASE, forcing the host client to verify whether the previous native tool call succeeded and settle the receipt via caop_settle_receipt first.
guarantees.note: Same one-open-lease rule and CAOP_409_UNSETTLED_EXECUTION_LEASE; MAOP adds fenced leases (Lease.fencing_token, monotonic) and leases.renew, so a stale holder cannot settle.

guarantees.text: Deployments operating in ChatGPT (Custom GPT Instructions) or Claude (Project / MCP System Prompt) MUST include the following normative instruction block:
guarantees.note: Normative block kept verbatim; the obligation is generalised from two named vendor hosts to any conversational host (vendor names become informative examples).

guarantees.spec_section: Normative Schema: Two-Phase Verification & Mid-Flight Steering
guarantees.text: An APPROVE_WITH_STEERING_DELTA decision binds the approval to the patched plan, not the staged one. The kernel MUST apply the delta, re-run every Policy pre-commit hook and minimum_attestation check on the patched plan, and dispatch only if all pass; otherwise the work item returns to CANDIDATE_PROPOSAL with CAOP_422_PRECOMMIT_HOOK_FAILED. A delta can only narrow authority: added_policy_constraints may add restrictions but never remove existing ones. [c]
guarantees.note: Same steering rule; MAOP states it as an authority Guard (a delta can only narrow an AuthorityGrant).

guarantees.spec_section: 15.2 Long-horizon context: sub-agents, compaction and lazy schemas [a]
guarantees.text: - **Hierarchical Sub-Agent Context Isolation:** Heavy research or artifact-generation steps spawn an isolated child Work scope (parent_work_id) with its own ephemeral scratchpad. When the child completes RECORD, its raw intermediate turns are discarded and only the ratified commitment and distilled bitemporal facts merge back into the parent control plane. Pruning removes raw traces from the active context, not from provenance: every promoted fact MUST keep a provenance pointer (child work_id, invocation IDs and a content hash of the pruned trace). Raw traces MAY be deleted only under a declared retention policy. [d]
guarantees.maop_section: Sub-agent isolation, compaction and lazy discovery
guarantees.note: Same provenance-pointer rule; MAOP adds Delegation (isolation policy, budget, authority subset) and Receipt.causal_parents so pruned traces stay traceable.
guarantees.spec_numbered_section: 15.2 Long-horizon context: sub-agents, compaction and lazy schemas [a]

supplementary_requirements.text: - In the reference kernel, a verification capability (`verification_capability_id`) must be side-effect-free: it may only read external state. Dispatch refuses a deferred check whose capability is not registered as side-effect-free.
- Receipt nonce: a Stage-1 receipt must echo the `required_nonce` from dispatch (`CAOP_422_VERIFY_ARTIFACT_MISMATCH` otherwise).
- Required receipt fields: the receipt’s `raw_output` must hold every field in the capability’s `required_receipt_fields`.
> **Critical requirement: provenance.** Every material fact should have a traceable origin.
A capability contract should describe what an operation *can do*, not merely what an agent is instructed to attempt.

> **Advisory vs. enforced.** A policy written in an assistant’s instructions is advisory. A policy enforced by a runtime before executing an action is an actual control. Every Creasura policy must state which it is.
supplementary_requirements.note: Kept; wording made vendor-neutral (no vendor or operating-system subject).

supplementary_requirements.text: > **Invariant:** replaying the same source event must not create duplicate observations.
This operation should distinguish retrieved facts from inferred interpretations.
The planner may use an LLM. The runtime must still validate the generated plan against schemas, dependencies, and policy constraints.
Verification can include deterministic checks, human approval, or model-based evaluation. **The verdict must identify which checks were performed.**
> **Invariant:** a conflicting state version must reject the transaction or invoke an explicitly defined conflict-resolution policy.
The eight lifecycle stages should not be confused with execution states.
The API must reject invalid transitions.

A transition from CREATED directly to COMPLETED should be rejected unless the work type explicitly supports that shortcut. The runtime persists each accepted transition with an actor, timestamp, reason, and correlation ID.
The boundary between the OS and the assistants and services that do the work. The OS must not assume every provider supports the same features.
supplementary_requirements.note: Kept; wording made vendor-neutral (no vendor or operating-system subject).

supplementary_requirements.text: > **Note:** Programmatic invocation of an assistant’s native work surfaces must use an explicitly supported interface. Do not assume arbitrary sessions can be launched through MCP.

> **v0.2:** An approval can steer the work it approves: APPROVE_WITH_STEERING_DELTA binds the approval to a patched plan, which must pass every policy check again. See [§15.1](#151-outcome-verification-and-approval-steering-a).

operations.justification: CAOP has principals but no agent identity: roles and capabilities could not be declared per agent, so separation of duties (implementer != reviewer != approver) could not be checked. Capabilities are advertised as stubs and hydrated lazily, preserving v0.2 lazy discovery.

v0.2 isolates child work (parent_work_id, isolation_policy) but only through stage_work. A first-class delegation lets a supervisor hand work to another agent with an isolation policy, a budget and an authority subset that can only narrow the parent's authority (Act->Coordinate edge).
Read model for a delegation and its child lifecycle state, so a supervisor can re-evaluate without polling executions one by one.

v0.2 leases have a timeout but no renewal or fencing. Renewal with a monotonic fencing_token prevents a holder whose lease expired from settling a receipt after another holder took over (split-brain).
Receipts were only returned inline by settle_receipt. A stable read path with idempotency_key, outcome (including outcome_unknown) and causal_parents makes recovery and audit possible after a crash.

CAOP re-evaluates only on pulse. Event-driven re-evaluation of durable guards returns the next outer transition (including Act->Decide, Act->Coordinate, Verify->Act and any->Recover) with the guards that passed and failed.

definitions.name: AgentIdentity
definitions.justification: Stable identity of an agent (who acts), distinct from PrincipalRef (who is accountable).

definitions.name: AgentRole
definitions.justification: Enum supervisor, planner, implementer, reviewer, verifier, approver, observer: needed for separation-of-duties guards.

definitions.name: AgentRegistration
definitions.justification: Request/response body of agents.register: identity, roles and lazily advertised capability stubs.

definitions.name: Delegation
definitions.justification: First-class supervisor-to-child work record: isolation policy, budget, authority subset, child lifecycle state.

definitions.name: AuthorityGrant
definitions.justification: Explicit, expiring, scoped authority with trust_level (T0_relayed, T1_attested); delegation and steering can only narrow it.

definitions.name: Lease
definitions.justification: Fenced execution lease (lease_id, holder, fencing_token, expires_at); generalises OpenLease.

definitions.name: LeaseRenewal
definitions.justification: Request body of leases.renew; the runtime rejects a stale fencing_token.

definitions.name: Receipt
definitions.justification: Durable action receipt (idempotency_key, outcome incl. outcome_unknown, evidence_refs, causal_parents) for audit and recovery.

definitions.name: SupervisionStage
definitions.justification: Enum of outer-lifecycle stages observe ... closed, including recover, so transitions are machine-checkable.

definitions.name: ChildLifecycleState
definitions.justification: Enum of child-work states proposed ... expired, mapping delegated work onto the inner lifecycle.

definitions.name: Guard
definitions.justification: Durable guard (authority, policy, evidence, freshness, lease, separation_of_duties, budget) re-evaluated on events, not only at commit.

definitions.name: TransitionDecision
definitions.justification: Result of evaluation: from_stage, to_stage, trigger, guards_passed, guards_failed, next_action.

definitions.name: CausalEvidence
definitions.justification: Evidence item with digest, derived_from and bitemporal times, linking receipts, facts and guards causally.
